features.name: Coin tiers

features.name: Clovers
features.description: Green and gold clovers boost nearby or all coin values.

review:
Le Viking puts Smokey, the raccoon from Le Bandit, in a horned helmet. The main event is Raid Spins: land six coins of any kind in the base game and you enter a hold-and-win round with three refilling lives, where coins, diamonds and clovers stick until the feature ends.

Each new coin, diamond or clover resets the lives to three; three blank respins in a row end the round. At the end, every coin and diamond reveals a cash value in bands that start as low as 0.2x for bronze, and clovers boost what's around them. It's a familiar format with Hacksaw's own touches, and the maximum is 10,000x.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
